title: Tunisian Chicken Fry
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Tunisian dish featuring chicken, juicy tomatoes, and spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion and ginger to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir for 1 minute.
Add the juicy tomatoes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken breast to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve hot garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
